newsitem.title: USA: DSC's SONET chosen by Bell Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: DSC's SONET chosen by Bell Atlantic.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp on Wednesday said Bell Atlantic Corp had chosen its integrated multi-rate transport node, a form of broadband digital network known as SONET, or Synchronous Optical Network.

The companies have signed a contract of an undisclosed value, and several systems are already installed as part of the evaluation procedure. An industry source told Reuters that the deal is worth tens of millions of dollars and the rivals competing for the deal were Japan's NEC Corp and France's Alcatel Alsthom.
Bell Atlantic and DSC declined comment on the value of the deal and others competing for it.
Bell Atlantic will use the nodes to support its high speed data communication and video transport needs. (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712))
